At Riverside, we pride ourselves on offering an exceptional education in a nurturing, family-like environment. Our school is home to a diverse international community that values creativity, innovation, and academic excellence. From our vibrant Primary School to our professionally-focused High School, Riverside provides an outstanding foundation for lifelong success.

With small class sizes, personalised learning, and world-class facilities, Riverside fosters curiosity, independence, and leadership in every student. Our experienced teachers bring passion and expertise to the classroom, creating a safe and inspiring place for children to grow and thrive.
Riverside’s small class sizes of around 18 students and high ratio of dedicated teachers ensure every child receives the individual attention they need to succeed.

From arts and music to sports and drama, Riverside inspires students to explore their interests and talents, guided by the English National Curriculum and the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP).
Riverside’s Skills for Life programme offers over 150 after-school activities, enhancing wellbeing and equipping students with skills for lifelong success.
With a focus on individual progress, Riverside students consistently exceed international standards, achieving outstanding academic success year after year.
Riverside graduates are accepted into leading universities around the world, a testament to the quality and depth of the Riverside experience.

I strongly believe that the primary school years are a transformative time for students to learn, grow, and challenge themselves in meaningful ways. It is also a unique opportunity for us to nurture curiosity, resilience, and empathy—qualities that inspire outstanding personal growth and empower our students to excel and contribute positively to the world around them.
Riverside graduates have been accepted to some of the most prestigious universities around the world.

pages.title: Riverside Mission & Values - Riverside International School in Prague
blocks: Riverside School values the uniqueness of the individual, providing high-quality education and skills for life to students of diverse cultures, within a Christian ethos and supportive family environment.
The staff team is dedicated to impacting students by building positive relationships and preparing them to become accomplished, global citizens.

Riverside International School seeks to champion the ideals of Challenge, Community and Care through every aspect of the School. Riverside’s Strategic Values encapsulate the Guiding Statements, including the Mission Statement and Core Principles . Decision-making, including strategic planning, is underpinned by the Strategic Values

The strategic value of Challenge is centered on the belief that excellence is achieved through setting the highest standards of academic rigour while promoting effort, perseverance, and resilience. Challenge involves providing high-quality education and skills for life, giving every child the opportunity to develop their full potential. In addition to academics, challenge at Riverside provides a holistic approach encompassing creative, personal, and social “for life” aspects.

Community reflects a diverse and inclusive school environment built on cooperation, understanding, and respect. Rooted in the school’s Christian ethos, it fosters positive relationships and values each individual, creating a space for social connection and nurtures compassionate, globally-minded citizens. The school aims to make a positive impact locally and beyond.

Care is rooted in the belief that every child is unique, valued, respected, and that their wellbeing is paramount. This creates a protective and supportive environment, giving students and the wider community a sense of home and belonging within Riverside’s international setting. Staff foster strong, trusting relationships through professional, relational approaches, with Care also encompassing mental health, safeguarding, and specialised student support.
The core principles for education at Riverside are set out below. These are reflected throughout the curriculum and life of the School.
Each child is valued and respected; each is unique.
Each child is cared for in a protective, secure, family-oriented environment.
The positive impact of the school staff is of critical importance to a successful school.
The school, privileged with diversity of culture, provides a space for social connection and develops globally-minded citizens.
The wellbeing of each child is of critical importance to the life of the individual and the school.
High-quality education provides an opportunity for each child to develop to their full potential.
Children develop positive relationships and attitudes to others.
The school makes a positive impact on the local and wider community.
Vision: Develop inspiring, accessible, and sustainable spaces that support challenge , learning, wellbeing, and community connection.
Vision : To advance the school’s strategic approach to High-Quality Teaching and Learning and challenge by leveraging digital innovation, including Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Vision: Empower students as active participants in decision-making while fostering a diverse and inclusive school community to enhance Riverside’s commitment to care

Vision : To demonstrate a deep commitment to environmental stewardship by embedding and continuously seeking to expand sustainable practices into all relevant school operations challenging our community to be caring, responsible global citizens.

Vision: To elevate the level of parent communication, ensuring it is consistent, transparent and multi-accessible, thereby strengthening the school-family partnership and maximising collaborative involvement across the whole school community.

pages.title: Early Years - Riverside International School in Prague
blocks: Let’s explore our Early Years School!
A Word from the Early Years Lead

My name is Hannah Gaffney and I would like to welcome you to Early Years. Our Early Years community is built on strong relationships, a nurturing environment, and a belief in every child’s potential. By encouraging curiosity, creativity, and exploration, we inspire our youngest learners to develop a lifelong love of learning and the confidence to embrace the world around them.
At Riverside Early Years, we follow the Statutory Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) Framework as set out by the Department for Education for England.
Learn about the Early Years – Curriculum & Parent’s Guide
The Early Years Foundation Stage Framework:
Sets the standards that all early years providers must meet to ensure that children learn and develop well.
Ensures children are kept healthy and safe.
Ensures children have the knowledge and skills they need to start school.

At Riverside, we understand that every child is unique and develops at their own pace. Our educators carefully plan and guide learning experiences to meet the individual needs of each student, recognizing the value and benefits of children learning through play. By embracing different learning styles and incorporating play-based activities, we create an environment where every child can thrive.
Children explore their world through their senses, showing curiosity about objects, events, and people. Open-ended activities encourage them to think creatively and discover new possibilities.
Enjoyment in acting out own experiences with others during play fosters creativity and social skills. This collaborative interaction allows them to engage in imaginative scenarios together.

Knowledge is demonstrated in play as children initiate activities that reflect their interests. They showcase a “can do” attitude, actively seek out challenges, and embrace risks by trying new things. This approach promotes learning through trial and error, helping to foster resilience and confidence.

Involvement and concentration are evident as children exhibit high levels of energy and fascination in their activities. They remain focused, not easily distracted, and pay close attention to details. This ability allows them to engage with tasks for extended periods, deepening their learning experience.

Children demonstrate the ability to keep trying by bouncing back after facing difficulties. They persist with activities even when challenges arise, believing that their persistence and adaptability will lead to success.

Children take pleasure in achieving their goals by embracing challenges as opportunities for growth, rather than just seeking praise. They feel a sense of pride not only in reaching their objectives but also in the effort and process that lead to those achievements.

Children show the ability to choose effective ways to do things by regularly checking how well an activity is going. They adapt by changing their approach or strategy when needed and are able to review how successful their method was in achieving the desired outcome.
Creativity is evident when new ways to do things are discovered, as well as when independent ideas are formed. This inventive approach helps in solving problems and encourages innovative thinking.

Making connections involves developing ideas about grouping, sequencing, and understanding cause and effect. It also includes making predictions, testing new ideas, and noticing patterns in experiences, allowing concepts to be linked in meaningful ways.

At Riverside, we believe in nurturing the whole child by developing not just academic foundations, but also real-world skills and passions. Our Skills for Life Clubs offer a wide range of enriching activities that inspire curiosity, confidence, and creativity from an early age. These clubs provide children with opportunities to explore new interests, build physical and social skills, and gain hands-on experiences that support their personal growth.

During the school day, the children will participate in a variety of timetabled activities to guide their learning, making use of our well resourced and carefully planned learning environments, both inside and outside.

Alongside teacher-led activities, we use ‘Continuous Provision’ with indoor and outdoor resources to promote skill-building, exploration, and vocabulary growth through enriched learning areas and meaningful conversations. More information about the CP model can be found in our Early Years Curriculum Guide.
Quiet Reading/Puzzles/Yoga time *Nursery Children can nap

At Riverside, we are committed to nurturing a love for the environment from an early age. Each year, our Early Years children take part in the Eco-Schools (Ekoskola) programme , working towards maintaining the internationally recognised Green Flag Award – a symbol of excellence in environmental education. Through hands-on projects and everyday eco-friendly practices, our youngest learners develop a strong sense of responsibility for the planet, helping to shape a greener future for all.
